assessment: In this manuscript, Zhang and colleagues created a transgenic mouse strain that express SYT-1-tdt in all neurons. They showed that the labelled SYT-1 does not represent a strong over expression, colocalizes with multiple synaptic markers and label synapses in different regions. Importantly, they showed that the transgenic expression does not alter synaptic function using electrophysiogical assays. This reagent can be used to visualize synapses in vivo and in cultures.
